name: Tumerok Fort (45.2S, 83.2W)
title: 45.2S, 83.2W - Tumerok Fort
summary: A Renegade Tumerok fort on a flat mesa top (z 68, about 60 m across) in the forested West Dires 3.7 km north of Ayan Baqur: three 30.75 m stone spire towers at (4500, 13596), (4524, 13620) and (4524, 13644) rise over four 5 m timber halls with plank spikes; the forest slopes 45 m down to the west (tower chest of low tier-4 loot, Gotrok Lugians and Tumeroks).

landmarks.name: West slope
landmarks.note: Forest floor z 22-30 rising to the rim at x 4460.

site.name: Tumerok Fort (45.2S, 83.2W)
site.notes: Derived teleport on the mesa top 33 m west-north-west of the fort centre, 18 m from the nearest hut.

shots.standingOrder: Rise from the forest floor west of the mesa up its slope and over the rim so the Tumerok fort and its three spire towers appear against the golden sky; keep 10 m above the rim.
shots.notes: Rising reveal up the forested west slope of the mesa: starts 3 m above the forest floor looking up the slope (the three 30.75 m spire towers peek over the rim), climbs 47 m while drifting 22 m forward and pitching from +13 to -6 deg until the whole fort, its huts and towers stand against the golden sky (0.77, sun behind). LOS to the subject centre is blocked by the rim until t 4.5 by design (the reveal's lead-in): 4/24 in the window.
